<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>어구독 예비고2 WEEK 01</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/orioncactus/pretendard@v1.3.9/dist/web/static/pretendard.min.css">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@200;300;400;500;600&family=Source+Serif+4:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=Nanum+Pen+Script&family=Inter:wght@400;600;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
@page { size: A4; margin: 0; }

html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #fff; }

:root { --ink: #121a33; --navy: #1b2a57; --acc: #ff5a1f; --acc2: #ffb800; --hl: #ffe45c; --gray: #6a6d76; --rule: #d3d6dd; --cream: #fbf7ef; }
.page { width: 210mm; height: 297mm; padding: 12mm 14mm 15mm; position: relative; overflow: hidden; break-after: page; }
.page:last-child { break-after: auto; }
.en { font-family: Inter, Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size: 9.2pt; line-height: 1.62; letter-spacing: -0.005em; }
.disp { font-family: "Black Han Sans", Pretendard, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; }
.hl { background: linear-gradient(transparent 58%, var(--hl) 58%); }
.tip { font-family: "Nanum Pen Script", cursive; font-weight: 400; color: var(--acc); font-size: 15pt; line-height: 1.15; }
.tip b { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 7pt; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #fff; background: var(--acc); padding: 0.6mm 1.6mm; border-radius: 1mm; margin-right: 2mm; vertical-align: 1.5pt; }
/* running head */
.run { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 7.4pt; color: var(--gray); margin-bottom: 5mm; }
.run .brand { font-family: "Archivo Black", sans-serif; color: var(--navy); letter-spacing: 0.06em; font-size: 7.6pt; }
.run .brand i { font-style: normal; color: var(--acc); }
.foot { position: absolute; left: 14mm; right: 14mm; bottom: 8mm; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 7.2pt; color: var(--gray); }
.foot .pg { font-family: "Archivo Black", sans-serif; color: var(--navy); font-size: 9pt; }
/* part head */
.part { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: end; column-gap: 4mm; padding-bottom: 2.5mm; border-bottom: 2pt solid var(--ink); margin-bottom: 4mm; }
.part .no { font-family: "Archivo Black", sans-serif; font-size: 44pt; line-height: 0.8; color: transparent; -webkit-text-stroke: 1.4pt var(--navy); }
.part .no.fill { color: var(--acc); -webkit-text-stroke: 0; }
.part .ttl .e { font-family: "Archivo Black", sans-serif; font-size: 18pt; color: var(--navy); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
.part .ttl .k { font-size: 9.6pt; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); margin-top: 1.2mm; }
.part .meta { text-align: right; font-size: 7.8pt; color: var(--gray); line-height: 1.35; }
.part .meta .time { font-family: "Black Han Sans"; color: var(--acc); font-size: 13pt; display: block; }
.qr { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 13mm; height: 13mm; border: 0.8pt dashed #9aa0ab; font-size: 5.8pt; color: var(--gray); text-align: center; line-height: 1.2; margin-left: 3mm; vertical-align: bottom; }
.part .meta-wrap { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; }
h3.pt { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 2.5mm; margin: 4.5mm 0 2mm; font-size: 11pt; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink); }
h3.pt .n { font-family: "Archivo Black", sans-serif; color: #fff; background: var(--navy); font-size: 7.6pt; padding: 0.6mm 1.8mm; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
h3.pt .n.o { background: var(--acc); }
h3.pt small { font-weight: 500; color: var(--gray); font-size: 8pt; margin-left: auto; }
.lead { margin: 0 0 3mm; color: #33363d; }
/* 판서노트 표 */
table.note { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 8.9pt; }
table.note th { text-align: left; font-size: 8pt; color: var(--gray); font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--ink); padding: 1.2mm 1.5mm; }
table.note td { border-bottom: 0.5pt solid var(--rule); padding: 1.9mm 1.5mm; vertical-align: top; }
table.note td.k { font-weight: 700; width: 46mm; }
table.note td.v { width: 30mm; }
.blank { display: inline-block; min-width: 18mm; border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--acc); text-align: center; color: transparent; }
.ex div { margin: 0.4mm 0; }
.ok { color: var(--acc); font-weight: 800; }
.chk { display: inline-block; width: 3.1mm; height: 3.1mm; border: 0.7pt solid #7d828c; vertical-align: -0.4mm; margin: 0 0.6mm; }
ol.q { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; counter-reset: q; }
ol.q > li { counter-increment: q; position: relative; padding-left: 7.5mm; margin-bottom: 2.1mm; }
ol.q > li::before { content: counter(q); position: absolute; left: 0; top: -0.3mm; font-family: "Archivo Black", sans-serif; color: var(--navy); font-size: 9pt; }
.cols2 { column-count: 2; column-gap: 7mm; column-rule: 0.5pt solid var(--rule); }
.cols2 > * { break-inside: avoid; }
.c { font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }
.ox { float: right; color: var(--gray); font-family: Inter; font-weight: 600; font-size: 8pt; }
.wl { display: inline-block; border-bottom: 0.6pt solid #8b9099; min-width: 30mm; height: 4mm; vertical-align: bottom; }
.line { border-bottom: 0.5pt solid #b9bdc5; height: 7mm; }
.passage { margin: 1mm 0 2.5mm; text-align: justify; }
.src { font-family: Inter; font-size: 7pt; color: var(--acc); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.qhead { font-weight: 800; margin: 0 0 1.4mm; font-size: 9.2pt; }
.qhead .src { margin-left: 1.5mm; }
.opts { font-size: 8.6pt; margin: 0 0 1mm; }
.opts div { margin: 0.4mm 0; }
.gloss { font-size: 7.2pt; color: var(--gray); text-align: right; margin-top: -1mm; margin-bottom: 1.5mm; }
.rd { break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 5mm; }
.pat { margin-bottom: 4.6mm; }
.pat .f { display: inline-block; font-family: Inter; font-weight: 800; font-size: 9pt; color: #fff; background: var(--ink); padding: 0.6mm 2.2mm; margin-right: 2mm; }
.pat .fk { font-weight: 700; }
.pat .s { margin: 1.6mm 0 0 0; }
.cond { font-size: 8.4pt; color: #333; border-top: 0.5pt solid var(--rule); border-bottom: 0.5pt solid var(--rule); padding: 1.4mm 0; margin: 1.2mm 0 2mm; }
.cond b { color: var(--navy); margin-right: 2mm; }
.bogi { font-family: Inter; font-size: 8.8pt; text-align: center; padding: 1.6mm 0; border-top: 1pt solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--ink); margin: 1.2mm 0 2mm; word-spacing: 1.5mm; }
.tr { margin-bottom: 2.4mm; }
.tr .no { font-family: "Archivo Black"; color: var(--navy); margin-right: 1.5mm; font-size: 8.6pt; }
/* voca */
table.voc { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 8.7pt; }
table.voc td { padding: 1.35mm 1mm; border-bottom: 0.5pt solid var(--rule); }
table.voc td.n { width: 6mm; font-family: "Archivo Black"; color: #a3a8b2; font-size: 7pt; }
table.voc td.w { font-family: Inter; font-weight: 700; width: 33mm; }
table.voc td.b { width: 30mm; }
/* plan */
table.grid { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 8.7pt; }
table.grid th { text-align: left; font-size: 7.8pt; color: var(--gray); font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--ink); padding: 1.4mm 1.5mm; }
table.grid td { border-bottom: 0.5pt solid var(--rule); padding: 2mm 1.5mm; }
table.grid td.no { font-family: "Archivo Black"; color: var(--acc); width: 10mm; }
.score { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr 1fr 1.4fr; border-top: 2pt solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 0.6pt solid var(--ink); margin-bottom: 4mm; }
.score div { padding: 1.6mm 2.5mm; border-right: 0.5pt solid var(--rule); height: 13mm; font-size: 7.8pt; color: var(--gray); }
.score div:last-child { border-right: 0; }
.score b { display: block; color: var(--ink); font-size: 8.2pt; }
.key h4 { font-family: "Archivo Black"; font-size: 8.6pt; color: var(--navy); margin: 3.4mm 0 1.2mm; letter-spacing: 0.04em; border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--ink); padding-bottom: 0.8mm; }
.key h4 span { font-family: Pretendard; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); margin-left: 1.5mm; }
.key .row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.6mm 4.5mm; font-size: 8.4pt; }
.key .row b { font-family: "Archivo Black"; color: var(--acc); margin-right: 1mm; font-size: 7.6pt; }
.key .ls div { font-size: 8.2pt; margin: 0.6mm 0; }
.key .ls b { font-family: "Archivo Black"; color: var(--acc); margin-right: 1.5mm; font-size: 7.6pt; }
/* cover */
.cover { padding: 0; color: #fff; background: radial-gradient(120% 80% at 75% 35%, #2d3f86 0%, #17214a 45%, #0b1024 100%); }
.cover svg.art { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 210mm; height: 297mm; }
.cover .top { position: absolute; left: 16mm; right: 16mm; top: 15mm; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 8.6pt; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.cover .pill { border: 0.8pt solid rgba(255,255,255,.75); border-radius: 10mm; padding: 1mm 3.2mm; font-weight: 600; }
.cover .series { opacity: .85; font-weight: 500; }
.cover .title { position: absolute; left: 16mm; top: 30mm; }
.cover .title .over { font-size: 11pt; font-weight: 600; opacity: .9; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
.cover .title h1 { font-family: "Black Han Sans"; font-weight: 400; font-size: 84pt; line-height: 1.02; margin: 2mm 0 0; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.cover .title h1 span { color: var(--acc2); }
.cover .title .sub { margin-top: 4mm; font-size: 13pt; font-weight: 700; display: flex; gap: 3mm; align-items: center; }
.cover .title .sub i { font-style: normal; font-weight: 500; opacity: .8; font-size: 10pt; }
.cover .band { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 64mm; background: #f2ff6b; color: var(--ink); padding: 9mm 16mm 0; }
.cover .band .who { font-size: 9.5pt; font-weight: 600; }
.cover .band .who b { color: #2440b3; }
.cover .band .slogan { font-family: "Black Han Sans"; font-size: 33pt; line-height: 1.1; margin-top: 2mm; }
.cover .band .feat { position: absolute; right: 16mm; top: 9mm; text-align: right; font-size: 8.2pt; line-height: 1.75; font-weight: 600; }
.cover .band .feat span { display: inline-block; background: var(--ink); color: #f2ff6b; padding: 0 2mm; margin-left: 1mm; font-size: 7.6pt; }
.cover .band .bot { position: absolute; left: 16mm; right: 16mm; bottom: 9mm; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 8.4pt; font-weight: 700; }
.cover .band .bot span { font-weight: 500; }
.memo { margin-top: 5mm; }
.memo .mh { font-family: "Archivo Black", Pretendard; font-size: 7.6pt; color: var(--navy); letter-spacing: .06em; border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--ink); padding-bottom: .8mm; }
.memo .line { border-bottom: .5pt dashed #c3c7cf; }
table.tf { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 8.4pt; margin-bottom: 1mm; }
table.tf td { border-bottom: .5pt solid var(--rule); padding: 1.2mm .5mm; }
table.tf td.b { width: 12mm; text-align: right; color: var(--gray); }
.sum { font-family: Inter; font-size: 8.6pt; border-top: .5pt solid var(--rule); border-bottom: .5pt solid var(--rule); padding: 1.3mm 0; margin: 0 0 1.4mm; }
.pair { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; font-family: Inter; font-size: 8.4pt; row-gap: .5mm; }
.q2 { margin-top: 3mm; }

:root { --brand: #213f93; --navy: #213f93; --tint: #eaf1fb; --tint2: #cfdcf2; --acc: #ff6a2b; --ink: #1a1d26; }
.page { padding: 19mm 16mm 15mm 14mm; }
.en { font-family: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif; font-size: 9.7pt; line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: 0; }
/* header band */
.run { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 11mm; margin: 0; padding: 0 16mm 0 14mm; background: var(--tint); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 7.6pt; color: var(--brand); }
.run .brand { background: var(--brand); color: #fff; padding: 1.2mm 2.6mm; font-size: 7.4pt; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.run .brand i { color: #ffd36b; }
.cover .run { display: none; }
/* thumb index */
.thumb { position: absolute; right: 0; width: 7.5mm; height: 27mm; background: var(--tint2); color: var(--brand); border-radius: 2mm 0 0 2mm; writing-mode: vertical-rl; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: "Archivo Black", sans-serif; font-size: 6.6pt; letter-spacing: .12em; }
.thumb.on { background: var(--brand); color: #fff; }
/* part head */
.part { border-bottom: 1.2pt solid var(--brand); padding-bottom: 2.6mm; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; }
.part .no, .part .no.fill { font-family: "Archivo Black"; font-size: 21pt; line-height: 1; color: #fff; -webkit-text-stroke: 0; background: var(--brand); padding: 2.2mm 3mm 2mm; border-radius: 1.6mm; }
.part .ttl .e { color: var(--brand); font-size: 16pt; }
.part .meta .time { color: var(--acc); }
/* section chips */
h3.pt .n { background: var(--brand); border-radius: 1mm; }
h3.pt .n.o { background: var(--acc); }
/* point boxes */
.box { border: .8pt solid var(--tint2); border-radius: 2.6mm; margin: 0 0 4mm; overflow: hidden; }
.box > h3.pt { margin: 0 0 2mm; background: var(--tint); padding: 1.8mm 3mm; }
.box > :not(h3) { margin-left: 3.5mm !important; margin-right: 3.5mm !important; }
.box > :last-child { margin-bottom: 3mm !important; }
/* 판서 빈칸 */
.blank { color: transparent; border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--acc); position: relative; min-width: 15mm; }
table.note td.v { width: 40mm; white-space: nowrap; }
table.note td.k { width: 50mm; }
.blank i { position: absolute; left: 0; top: -0.5mm; color: var(--acc); font-style: normal; font-weight: 800; font-size: 8pt; }
/* choice box */
.c { white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 600; }
.c b { display: inline-block; border: .7pt solid #8796b8; padding: 0 1.4mm; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; }
.c b + b { border-left: 0; }
/* tables */
table.note th, table.grid th { color: var(--brand); border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--brand); background: var(--tint); }
table.grid td.no { color: var(--brand); }
ol.q > li::before { color: var(--brand); font-family: "Archivo Black"; content: counter(q, decimal-leading-zero); }
ol.q > li { padding-left: 8mm; }
.exwrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 38mm; column-gap: 5mm; }
.vside { border-left: .6pt solid var(--tint2); padding-left: 3mm; font-size: 7.8pt; line-height: 1.55; }
.vside h5 { margin: 0 0 1.5mm; font-family: "Archivo Black"; font-size: 7pt; color: var(--brand); letter-spacing: .08em; }
.vside div { margin-bottom: 1.2mm; }
.vside div span { font-family: "Source Serif 4", serif; font-weight: 600; display: block; color: var(--ink); font-size: 8.3pt; }
.score { border-top: 1.4pt solid var(--brand); }
.key h4 { color: var(--brand); border-bottom-color: var(--brand); }
.memo .mh { color: var(--brand); border-bottom-color: var(--brand); }
.foot .pg { color: var(--brand); }
.tip b { background: var(--acc); }
.src { color: var(--acc); }
.cover .band .who b { color: var(--brand); }

.qc { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; column-gap: 7mm; row-gap: 1.6mm; }
.qc > div { position: relative; padding-left: 7mm; }
.qc > div > em { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; font-style: normal; font-family: "Archivo Black"; color: var(--brand); font-size: 8.4pt; }
.fillw { display: inline-block; min-width: 16mm; border-bottom: .6pt solid #8b9099; }
.abc { font-family: "Source Serif 4", serif; font-size: 8.8pt; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6mm 1fr 1fr 1fr; row-gap: .4mm; margin-top: 1.5mm; }
.abc span.h { color: var(--gray); font-family: Pretendard; font-size: 7.8pt; }

.key .row { font-size: 7.9pt; gap: 0.3mm 3.6mm; }
.key .ls div { font-size: 7.7pt; margin: 0.3mm 0; }
.key h4 { margin: 2.2mm 0 0.8mm; }
.bogi2 { font-family: "Source Serif 4", serif; font-size: 8.8pt; text-align: center; border: .7pt solid var(--tint2); border-radius: 1.5mm; background: var(--tint); padding: 1.3mm 0; margin: 0 0 2mm; word-spacing: 2mm; }

table.note td { padding: 1.3mm 1.2mm; font-size: 8.3pt; }
table.note td.k { width: 40mm !important; }
table.note td.v { width: 33mm !important; white-space: normal !important; }
table.note td.en { font-size: 8.9pt; line-height: 1.45; }
.key .row { font-size: 7.6pt !important; }
.key .ls div { font-size: 7.5pt !important; }
.ta{display:none} .c b.ans{}

html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #fff; }
body { font-family: Pretendard, sans-serif; color: #17181c; font-size: 9.2pt; line-height: 1.5; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
:root { --ink: #121a33; --navy: #1b2a57; --acc: #ff5a1f; --acc2: #ffb800; --hl: #ffe45c; --gray: #6a6d76; --rule: #d3d6dd; --cream: #fbf7ef; }
.page { width: 210mm; height: 297mm; padding: 12mm 14mm 15mm; position: relative; overflow: hidden; break-after: page; }
.page:last-child { break-after: auto; }
.en { font-family: Inter, Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size: 9.2pt; line-height: 1.62; letter-spacing: -0.005em; }
.disp { font-family: "Black Han Sans", Pretendard, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; }
.hl { background: linear-gradient(transparent 58%, var(--hl) 58%); }
.tip { font-family: "Nanum Pen Script", cursive; font-weight: 400; color: var(--acc); font-size: 15pt; line-height: 1.15; }
.tip b { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 7pt; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #fff; background: var(--acc); padding: 0.6mm 1.6mm; border-radius: 1mm; margin-right: 2mm; vertical-align: 1.5pt; }
/* running head */
.run { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 7.4pt; color: var(--gray); margin-bottom: 5mm; }
.run .brand { font-family: "Archivo Black", sans-serif; color: var(--navy); letter-spacing: 0.06em; font-size: 7.6pt; }
.run .brand i { font-style: normal; color: var(--acc); }
.foot { position: absolute; left: 14mm; right: 14mm; bottom: 8mm; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 7.2pt; color: var(--gray); }
.foot .pg { font-family: "Archivo Black", sans-serif; color: var(--navy); font-size: 9pt; }
/* part head */
.part { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: end; column-gap: 4mm; padding-bottom: 2.5mm; border-bottom: 2pt solid var(--ink); margin-bottom: 4mm; }
.part .no { font-family: "Archivo Black", sans-serif; font-size: 44pt; line-height: 0.8; color: transparent; -webkit-text-stroke: 1.4pt var(--navy); }
.part .no.fill { color: var(--acc); -webkit-text-stroke: 0; }
.part .ttl .e { font-family: "Archivo Black", sans-serif; font-size: 18pt; color: var(--navy); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
.part .ttl .k { font-size: 9.6pt; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); margin-top: 1.2mm; }
.part .meta { text-align: right; font-size: 7.8pt; color: var(--gray); line-height: 1.35; }
.part .meta .time { font-family: "Black Han Sans"; color: var(--acc); font-size: 13pt; display: block; }
.qr { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 13mm; height: 13mm; border: 0.8pt dashed #9aa0ab; font-size: 5.8pt; color: var(--gray); text-align: center; line-height: 1.2; margin-left: 3mm; vertical-align: bottom; }
.part .meta-wrap { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; }
h3.pt { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 2.5mm; margin: 4.5mm 0 2mm; font-size: 11pt; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink); }
h3.pt .n { font-family: "Archivo Black", sans-serif; color: #fff; background: var(--navy); font-size: 7.6pt; padding: 0.6mm 1.8mm; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
h3.pt .n.o { background: var(--acc); }
h3.pt small { font-weight: 500; color: var(--gray); font-size: 8pt; margin-left: auto; }
.lead { margin: 0 0 3mm; color: #33363d; }
/* 판서노트 표 */
table.note { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 8.9pt; }
table.note th { text-align: left; font-size: 8pt; color: var(--gray); font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--ink); padding: 1.2mm 1.5mm; }
table.note td { border-bottom: 0.5pt solid var(--rule); padding: 1.9mm 1.5mm; vertical-align: top; }
table.note td.k { font-weight: 700; width: 46mm; }
table.note td.v { width: 30mm; }
.blank { display: inline-block; min-width: 18mm; border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--acc); text-align: center; color: transparent; }
.ex div { margin: 0.4mm 0; }
.ok { color: var(--acc); font-weight: 800; }
.chk { display: inline-block; width: 3.1mm; height: 3.1mm; border: 0.7pt solid #7d828c; vertical-align: -0.4mm; margin: 0 0.6mm; }
ol.q { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; counter-reset: q; }
ol.q > li { counter-increment: q; position: relative; padding-left: 7.5mm; margin-bottom: 2.1mm; }
ol.q > li::before { content: counter(q); position: absolute; left: 0; top: -0.3mm; font-family: "Archivo Black", sans-serif; color: var(--navy); font-size: 9pt; }
.cols2 { column-count: 2; column-gap: 7mm; column-rule: 0.5pt solid var(--rule); }
.cols2 > * { break-inside: avoid; }
.c { font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }
.ox { float: right; color: var(--gray); font-family: Inter; font-weight: 600; font-size: 8pt; }
ol.q > li:has(.ox)::after { content: ""; display: block; clear: both; }
.wl { display: inline-block; border-bottom: 0.6pt solid #8b9099; min-width: 30mm; height: 4mm; vertical-align: bottom; }
.line { border-bottom: 0.5pt solid #b9bdc5; height: 7mm; }
.passage { margin: 1mm 0 2.5mm; text-align: justify; }
.src { font-family: Inter; font-size: 7pt; color: var(--acc); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.qhead { font-weight: 800; margin: 0 0 1.4mm; font-size: 9.2pt; }
.qhead .src { margin-left: 1.5mm; }
.opts { font-size: 8.6pt; margin: 0 0 1mm; }
.opts div { margin: 0.4mm 0; }
.gloss { font-size: 7.2pt; color: var(--gray); text-align: right; margin-top: -1mm; margin-bottom: 1.5mm; }
.rd { break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 5mm; }
.pat { margin-bottom: 4.6mm; }
.pat .f { display: inline-block; font-family: Inter; font-weight: 800; font-size: 9pt; color: #fff; background: var(--ink); padding: 0.6mm 2.2mm; margin-right: 2mm; }
.pat .fk { font-weight: 700; }
.pat .s { margin: 1.6mm 0 0 0; }
.cond { font-size: 8.4pt; color: #333; border-top: 0.5pt solid var(--rule); border-bottom: 0.5pt solid var(--rule); padding: 1.4mm 0; margin: 1.2mm 0 2mm; }
.cond b { color: var(--navy); margin-right: 2mm; }
.bogi { font-family: Inter; font-size: 8.8pt; text-align: center; padding: 1.6mm 0; border-top: 1pt solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--ink); margin: 1.2mm 0 2mm; word-spacing: 1.5mm; }
.tr { margin-bottom: 2.4mm; }
.tr .no { font-family: "Archivo Black"; color: var(--navy); margin-right: 1.5mm; font-size: 8.6pt; }
/* voca */
table.voc { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 8.7pt; }
table.voc td { padding: 1.35mm 1mm; border-bottom: 0.5pt solid var(--rule); }
table.voc td.n { width: 6mm; font-family: "Archivo Black"; color: #a3a8b2; font-size: 7pt; }
table.voc td.w { font-family: Inter; font-weight: 700; width: 33mm; }
table.voc td.b { width: 30mm; }
/* plan */
table.grid { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 8.7pt; }
table.grid th { text-align: left; font-size: 7.8pt; color: var(--gray); font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--ink); padding: 1.4mm 1.5mm; }
table.grid td { border-bottom: 0.5pt solid var(--rule); padding: 2mm 1.5mm; }
table.grid td.no { font-family: "Archivo Black"; color: var(--acc); width: 10mm; }
.score { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr 1fr 1.4fr; border-top: 2pt solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 0.6pt solid var(--ink); margin-bottom: 4mm; }
.score div { padding: 1.6mm 2.5mm; border-right: 0.5pt solid var(--rule); height: 13mm; font-size: 7.8pt; color: var(--gray); }
.score div:last-child { border-right: 0; }
.score b { display: block; color: var(--ink); font-size: 8.2pt; }
.key h4 { font-family: "Archivo Black"; font-size: 8.6pt; color: var(--navy); margin: 3.4mm 0 1.2mm; letter-spacing: 0.04em; border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--ink); padding-bottom: 0.8mm; }
.key h4 span { font-family: Pretendard; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); margin-left: 1.5mm; }
.key .row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.6mm 4.5mm; font-size: 8.4pt; }
.key .row b { font-family: "Archivo Black"; color: var(--acc); margin-right: 1mm; font-size: 7.6pt; }
.key .ls div { font-size: 8.2pt; margin: 0.6mm 0; }
.key .ls b { font-family: "Archivo Black"; color: var(--acc); margin-right: 1.5mm; font-size: 7.6pt; }
/* cover */
.cover { padding: 0; color: #fff; background: radial-gradient(120% 80% at 75% 35%, #2d3f86 0%, #17214a 45%, #0b1024 100%); }
.cover svg.art { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 210mm; height: 297mm; }
.cover .top { position: absolute; left: 16mm; right: 16mm; top: 15mm; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 8.6pt; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.cover .pill { border: 0.8pt solid rgba(255,255,255,.75); border-radius: 10mm; padding: 1mm 3.2mm; font-weight: 600; }
.cover .series { opacity: .85; font-weight: 500; }
.cover .title { position: absolute; left: 16mm; top: 30mm; }
.cover .title .over { font-size: 11pt; font-weight: 600; opacity: .9; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
.cover .title h1 { font-family: "Black Han Sans"; font-weight: 400; font-size: 84pt; line-height: 1.02; margin: 2mm 0 0; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.cover .title h1 span { color: var(--acc2); }
.cover .title .sub { margin-top: 4mm; font-size: 13pt; font-weight: 700; display: flex; gap: 3mm; align-items: center; }
.cover .title .sub i { font-style: normal; font-weight: 500; opacity: .8; font-size: 10pt; }
.cover .band { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 64mm; background: #f2ff6b; color: var(--ink); padding: 9mm 16mm 0; }
.cover .band .who { font-size: 9.5pt; font-weight: 600; }
.cover .band .who b { color: #2440b3; }
.cover .band .slogan { font-family: "Black Han Sans"; font-size: 33pt; line-height: 1.1; margin-top: 2mm; }
.cover .band .feat { position: absolute; right: 16mm; top: 9mm; text-align: right; font-size: 8.2pt; line-height: 1.75; font-weight: 600; }
.cover .band .feat span { display: inline-block; background: var(--ink); color: #f2ff6b; padding: 0 2mm; margin-left: 1mm; font-size: 7.6pt; }
.cover .band .bot { position: absolute; left: 16mm; right: 16mm; bottom: 9mm; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 8.4pt; font-weight: 700; }
.cover .band .bot span { font-weight: 500; }
.memo { margin-top: 5mm; }
.memo .mh { font-family: "Archivo Black", Pretendard; font-size: 7.6pt; color: var(--navy); letter-spacing: .06em; border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--ink); padding-bottom: .8mm; }
.memo .line { border-bottom: .5pt dashed #c3c7cf; }
table.tf { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 8.4pt; margin-bottom: 1mm; }
table.tf td { border-bottom: .5pt solid var(--rule); padding: 1.2mm .5mm; }
table.tf td.b { width: 12mm; text-align: right; color: var(--gray); }
.sum { font-family: Inter; font-size: 8.6pt; border-top: .5pt solid var(--rule); border-bottom: .5pt solid var(--rule); padding: 1.3mm 0; margin: 0 0 1.4mm; }
.pair { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; font-family: Inter; font-size: 8.4pt; row-gap: .5mm; }
.q2 { margin-top: 3mm; }

:root { --brand: #213f93; --navy: #213f93; --tint: #eaf1fb; --tint2: #cfdcf2; --acc: #ff6a2b; --ink: #1a1d26; }
.page { padding: 19mm 16mm 15mm 14mm; }
.en { font-family: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif; font-size: 9.7pt; line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: 0; }
/* header band */
.run { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 11mm; margin: 0; padding: 0 16mm 0 14mm; background: var(--tint); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 7.6pt; color: var(--brand); }
.run .brand { background: var(--brand); color: #fff; padding: 1.2mm 2.6mm; font-size: 7.4pt; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.run .brand i { color: #ffd36b; }
.cover .run { display: none; }
/* thumb index */
.thumb { position: absolute; right: 0; width: 7.5mm; height: 27mm; background: var(--tint2); color: var(--brand); border-radius: 2mm 0 0 2mm; writing-mode: vertical-rl; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: "Archivo Black", sans-serif; font-size: 6.6pt; letter-spacing: .12em; }
.thumb.on { background: var(--brand); color: #fff; }
/* part head */
.part { border-bottom: 1.2pt solid var(--brand); padding-bottom: 2.6mm; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; }
.part .no, .part .no.fill { font-family: "Archivo Black"; font-size: 21pt; line-height: 1; color: #fff; -webkit-text-stroke: 0; background: var(--brand); padding: 2.2mm 3mm 2mm; border-radius: 1.6mm; }
.part .ttl .e { color: var(--brand); font-size: 16pt; }
.part .meta .time { color: var(--acc); }
/* section chips */
h3.pt .n { background: var(--brand); border-radius: 1mm; }
h3.pt .n.o { background: var(--acc); }
/* point boxes */
.box { border: .8pt solid var(--tint2); border-radius: 2.6mm; margin: 0 0 4mm; overflow: hidden; }
.box > h3.pt { margin: 0 0 2mm; background: var(--tint); padding: 1.8mm 3mm; }
.box > :not(h3) { margin-left: 3.5mm !important; margin-right: 3.5mm !important; }
.box > :last-child { margin-bottom: 3mm !important; }
/* 판서 빈칸 */
.blank { color: transparent; border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--acc); position: relative; min-width: 15mm; }
table.note td.v { width: 40mm; white-space: nowrap; }
table.note td.k { width: 50mm; }
.blank i { position: absolute; left: 0; top: -0.5mm; color: var(--acc); font-style: normal; font-weight: 800; font-size: 8pt; }
/* choice box */
.c { white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 600; }
.c b { display: inline-block; border: .7pt solid #8796b8; padding: 0 1.4mm; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; }
.c b + b { border-left: 0; }
/* tables */
table.note th, table.grid th { color: var(--brand); border-bottom: 1pt solid var(--brand); background: var(--tint); }
table.grid td.no { color: var(--brand); }
ol.q > li::before { color: var(--brand); font-family: "Archivo Black"; content: counter(q, decimal-leading-zero); }
ol.q > li { padding-left: 8mm; }
.exwrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 38mm; column-gap: 5mm; }
.vside { border-left: .6pt solid var(--tint2); padding-left: 3mm; font-size: 7.8pt; line-height: 1.55; }
.vside h5 { margin: 0 0 1.5mm; font-family: "Archivo Black"; font-size: 7pt; color: var(--brand); letter-spacing: .08em; }
.vside div { margin-bottom: 1.2mm; }
.vside div span { font-family: "Source Serif 4", serif; font-weight: 600; display: block; color: var(--ink); font-size: 8.3pt; }
.score { border-top: 1.4pt solid var(--brand); }
.key h4 { color: var(--brand); border-bottom-color: var(--brand); }
.memo .mh { color: var(--brand); border-bottom-color: var(--brand); }
.foot .pg { color: var(--brand); }
.tip b { background: var(--acc); }
.src { color: var(--acc); }
.cover .band .who b { color: var(--brand); }

.qc { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; column-gap: 7mm; row-gap: 1.6mm; }
.qc > div { position: relative; padding-left: 7mm; }
.qc > div > em { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; font-style: normal; font-family: "Archivo Black"; color: var(--brand); font-size: 8.4pt; }
.fillw { display: inline-block; min-width: 16mm; border-bottom: .6pt solid #8b9099; }
.abc { font-family: "Source Serif 4", serif; font-size: 8.8pt; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6mm 1fr 1fr 1fr; row-gap: .4mm; margin-top: 1.5mm; }
.abc span.h { color: var(--gray); font-family: Pretendard; font-size: 7.8pt; }

.key .row { font-size: 7.9pt; gap: 0.3mm 3.6mm; }
.key .ls div { font-size: 7.7pt; margin: 0.3mm 0; }
.key h4 { margin: 2.2mm 0 0.8mm; }
.bogi2 { font-family: "Source Serif 4", serif; font-size: 8.8pt; text-align: center; border: .7pt solid var(--tint2); border-radius: 1.5mm; background: var(--tint); padding: 1.3mm 0; margin: 0 0 2mm; word-spacing: 2mm; }

table.note td { padding: 1.3mm 1.2mm; font-size: 8.3pt; }
table.note td.k { width: 40mm !important; }
table.note td.v { width: 33mm !important; white-space: normal !important; }
table.note td.en { font-size: 8.9pt; line-height: 1.45; }
.key .row { font-size: 7.6pt !important; }
.key .ls div { font-size: 7.5pt !important; }
